title: The Second Wife
author: Barış Kısır
premise: When Helena marries the widower Daniel, she inherits a house arranged by his first wife — every room, every shelf, every photograph placed by a woman she never met. Over one year, Helena must decide whether she is living in a shrine or a home, and whether the first wife\'s absence is a ghost or a gift.
